quest_name: Moon and Star (killed the Nerevarine unhired)
outcome: Hunted down and killed the Nerevarine without even being contracted to, out of pride
citation: B02 tier A terminal: s48 'Even though I was not hired to do so, I killed him all the same. Surely if I can kill even the Nerevarine, none can stand before me!' Tagged as murder rather than assassination_contract precisely because the journal says there was no contract for it.
branch_note: Branch 1 of 6 mutually-exclusive endings. This is the worst-faith one: no contract, no provocation, pride alone.

quest_name: Moon and Star (killed the Nerevarine and the broker)
outcome: Killed the Nerevarine under contract and then killed Mandyn Hlaalu rather than deal with him
citation: B02 tier A terminal: s49 'I killed the Nerevarine, as I was hired to do, but I did not want to cooperate with Mandyn Hlaalu and slew him on the spot. Serves him right for trying to toy with me.'
branch_note: Branch 2 of 6. Both parties dead; the second killing is unprovoked.

outcome: Killed the Nerevarine for the contract and took Mandyn Hlaalu's payment
citation: B02 tier A terminal: s50 'Mandyn Hlaalu rewarded me for slaying the Nerevarine, and went on his way.' Rejected generic reads: keep_oath is NOT applied - a murder contract taken under a false House Hlaalu pretext is not a vow any god honours.
branch_note: Branch 3 of 6. Stages 50, 53 and 55 are the same outcome with different flavour text and are rowed separately because the mod can land on any one of them.

outcome: Spared the Nerevarine and helped him destroy an ancient Dwemer weapon for the good of Tamriel
citation: B02 tier A terminal: s70 'I agreed to help him destroy an ancient Dwemer weapon, for the good of Tamriel' and s92 'The Nerevarine gave me a powerful artifact for helping him defeat the ancient Dwemer weapon.' Rejected generic reads: break_oath_betray is NOT applied - Mandyn is a Morag Tong assassin who lied about acting for House Hlaalu, and refusing a deceiver's murder contract is not oath-breaking.

outcome: Played a child's game with Albert in Little Vivec and found all three of his lost stuffed dogs
citation: B02 tier A terminal: s30 'I played a rousing game of ''apocadypse'' with a boy named Albert in Little Vivec, where I managed to find the three dogs and stop the apocadypse.'
branch_note: NEEDS-TAG: kindness shown to a child for its own sake. Part A has no primitive for it - charity is alms to the poor, heal_comfort is the sick and the grieving, protect_the_weak is rescue from danger, and none of them is an adult indulging a child's game. Rowed with an empty tag rather than forced into the nearest wrong one; Mara is the obvious reader if a tag is ever added.
